task.description:
WF-02, step 2 — write the code of REQ-104 by the design docs/design/REQ-104-e2e-chrome-kit.md (it passed gate 1b on the third pass, handoffs/E2E104-20261103-01/step-01f-code-design-validator.json), in the 8 build sub-steps of design section 15, and only in the files that section 3 gives to BACKEND-DEV. The answers of ORCH are in decisions/0107 and decisions/0108 (binding). Read the design completely, the block REQ-104 in docs/requirements.yaml, docs/quality-bar.md and docs/anti-patterns.md first.

RULES: pure Node 22, no npm package. After EACH sub-step run the checks named in the design for that sub-step and name the red tests; only the six guard tests (HC-02, HC-03, HO-54, PK-7b, LP-3, CTL-13) may turn red, and only at sub-step 7 (the package.json edit); any other red test is a stop and a report to ORCH. Tests of the kit (tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js, smoke.e2e.js, fixtures/e2e/specs and tap) are NOT yours: they are written by TEST-DESIGNER at step 5; so in sub-steps 1-6 check your modules with your own throw-away probes OUTSIDE the project (system temp folder) and in sub-step 7 run the whole `cd tools && npm run check`-parts that the design names. The guard tests turned red at sub-step 7 are fixed by TEST-DESIGNER at step 5 — report them in result.issues with the section of the design.
Do not depart silently from the design; if something cannot be built as designed, stop and write it in result.issues for ORCH. The Low remarks of gate 1b for the developers (handoffs/E2E104-20261103-01/step-01f-code-design-validator.json, N1-N6) and the open points of the designer (check whether fs.writeSync gives EAGAIN on a non-blocking pipe for the stand-in `noisy` mode; the path form node prints for a spec) are yours to follow: N4 — cleanupAllSync clears the registry after killing, so a group is not killed twice. Do not put the words forbidden by the design (the sandbox flags, skip words, `|| true`, `eslint-disable`) anywhere under tools/test/e2e, in tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js or in the stand-in, comments included; no secret; no absolute machine path in any committed file (npm run traces); the root README.md is edited by hand, not through prettier; format the new code under tools/ with `cd tools && npx prettier --write <your files>` and run `npm run lint`.
SAFETY ON THIS MAC: one agent at a time; start Chrome only with the kit's own cleanup, kill any Chrome you start by process id (never by name pattern), remove only the temp folders you created, never rm inside the project; at most two full `npm test` runs in the whole step. Final self-check: `cd tools && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run traces && npm run handoffs-check` and a real run of the new `node test/e2e/run.js` form you built (preflight prints `e2e: browser=` with the real Chrome here); the full suite is not green until step 5 fixes the six guard tests — name exactly which are red.
Do not commit. No name of another project in any file.

issues.text: Six guard tests red from sub-step 7, replaced by TEST-DESIGNER at step 5 by section 12 of the design: HC-02 (row 1, six steps list), HC-03 (row 2, end `npm run test && npm run e2e`), HO-54 (row 3, six steps), PK-7b (row 4, string + ` && npm run e2e`), LP-3 (row 5, 19 keys with e2e between test and check), CTL-13 (row 6, `/npm run test && npm run e2e$/`). No other test red.

The acceptance criterion 'a real run of the runner prints e2e: browser= with the real Chrome' cannot be met on the real tree yet: smoke.e2e.js does not exist before step 5, so listSpecs gives NO_SPECS before the preflight (design 15 step 6 says so). It was done on a scratch copy with a trivial spec (see self_check). Please repeat on the real tree after step 5.

Behaviour added beyond the letter of the design, for ORCH/CODE-DESIGNER to confirm: Page.goto/reload wait 100 ms after the load event (LOAD_SETTLE_MS). Measured: with a second navigation started at once, Chrome drops the favicon request and its console line EVERY time (3 of 3), with a 50 ms gap it appears every time (3 of 3, also at 400 ms). Without the settle SMK-08 ('two loads in one start, exactly one favicon entry') would fail on every run. Cost 0.1 s per goto.

Contract details TEST-DESIGNER must know (not fixed in the design): (a) a console declaration is {kind, text, path?, once?}; evaluateConsole(entries, declarations) reads `once` (true = expectOncePerStart); makeDeclaration() builds it; entryFromEvent(message,{page,at}) and consoleError(unexpected, unmet) are exported from console.js; (b) runAll `out`/`err` accept an object with write(text) or a plain function(text); the defaults write synchronously to fd 1/2; `now` is a function returning ms; (c) guards return the normalized href / the real path (symbolic links resolved) and callers use that value; (d) the stand-in has an extra mode ok-ignore-term (like ok, ignores SIGTERM) because hang-ignore-term prints no port line, so no Browser can be built on it: E2K-17 'close() escalates to SIGKILL' must use ok-ignore-term (the hang-ignore-term mode still covers the START_TIMEOUT kill); (e) bad-json/error-object/no-answer make launchBrowser itself reject (Browser.getVersion is the first call), so E2K-13/14/15 and the two-pending-calls case need cdp.connect on the stand-in's port line directly or accept the launch rejection; (f) Page.waitFor lets a PROTOCOL_ERROR of a poll pass (a page that is changing) and rethrows everything else.

Module order differs from the arrow list of section 3 in one place without effect: browser.js imports page.js (newPage), page.js does not import browser.js, so there is no cycle. page.js was written before the sub-step 4 driver ran (browser.js imports it); sub-step 4 checks did not use pages.

Open points of the designer answered: fs.writeSync(2, …) of the `noisy` mode gave 0 EAGAIN on the child pipe (probe: it blocks after 32 chunks of 4 KB while the parent does not read, finishes after the read; the stand-in still retries on EAGAIN). The path form node prints for a spec is the relative one without './' (`ok 1 - test/e2e/empty.e2e.js`). N4 done (cleanupAllSync clears the registry); N3 (hooks run at once) built as designed, a test needs two hooks of 600 ms with a 1000 ms limit (probe: both markers appear). N1, N2, N5, N6 touch the tests only.

Safety: only my own scratch folder was used as TMPDIR for kit runs; every Chrome was started by the kit (cleanup verified, pgrep 'sai-e2e-profile' = 0, no stand-in left); the owner's own Chrome was never touched. One full test run used (the limit is two).
